item.title: This NATO Country Just Got More Leopard 2 Tanks
item.description: Hungary’s Leopard 2 tanks are intended to replace its existing T-72s—but there is little chance that it will donate the older tanks to Ukraine, as other NATO nations have. The post This NATO Country Just Got More Leopard 2 Tanks appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: The US Air Force Is Buying Two More Boeing 747s to Support Air Force One
item.description: Because aerospace giant Boeing no longer manufactures the 747, additional parts will be needed over time to keep the main Air Force One flying. The post The US Air Force Is Buying Two More Boeing 747s to Support Air Force One appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: Trump Announces New Class of Battleships—Named for Himself
item.description: The hypothetical Trump-class battleship would displace between 30,000 and 40,000 tons—making them roughly two-thirds the size of the Iowa-class battleships of World War II. The post Trump Announces New Class of Battleships—Named for Himself appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: After Months of Labor Unrest, F-15EX Eagle II Deliveries Are Back on Track
item.description: Somewhat ironically, given its moniker as the "Strike Eagle," the F-15EX’s delivery to the US Air Force was delayed for months by a labor strike. The post After Months of Labor Unrest, F-15EX Eagle II Deliveries Are Back on Track appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: Ukraine’s Underwater Drone Cripples a Russian Submarine
item.description: Through the Ukraine War, the Russian Navy has lost over 20 warships, submarines, landing ships, patrol boats, and support vessels, including its flagship, the Moskva guided-missile cruiser. The post Ukraine’s Underwater Drone Cripples a Russian Submarine appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: Kadena: This Is the ISR Network China Fears Most
item.description: In a potential conflict with China, the US military and its partners will rely on ISR assets to provide important information domination capabilities. The post Kadena: This Is the ISR Network China Fears Most appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: Finland Arms Its F-35s With America’s Deadliest Air Missile
item.description: The advanced AIM-120D3 air-to-air missiles will equip Finland’s new fleet of 64 F-35A Lightning II stealth fighter jets. The post Finland Arms Its F-35s With America’s Deadliest Air Missile appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: US Military’s Southern Command Gets a Special Ops Boss
item.description: The Pentagon’s recurrent elevation of special suggests that Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth particularly values discipline and lethality at the department’s senior-most levels. The post US Military’s Southern Command Gets a Special Ops Boss appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: How China Turned the Arab Spring to Its Advantage
item.description: China’s inroads in the Middle East demonstrate how the region is still a critical front in the era of US-China competition. The post How China Turned the Arab Spring to Its Advantage appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: Defining Success in the Second Phase of Gaza’s Ceasefire
item.description: Between Hamas disarmament, transitional governance, and international stabilization, the second phase of the Gaza peace plan juggles multiple and clashing moving parts. The post Defining Success in the Second Phase of Gaza’s Ceasefire appeared first on The National Interest.
